eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA status I and II
* Orthopedic leg operations under spinal anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Spinal deformity
* Coagulopathy (INR \>1.5)
* Allergic reaction to local anesthetic
* Recent heart attack (≤3-months)
* With neurological diseases
* Pulmonary diseases
* Major liver or kidney disorders and infection of skin at the block site

identificationModule.briefTitle: Comparison of Pain Relief Duration With Dexmedetomidine Versus Fentanyl Added to Spinal Anesthesia in Patients Undergoing Lower Limb Orthopedic Surgery
